name: GVDB Raycasting with Binary Search Surface Tracing
definition: A GPU raycasting kernel that traces rays through a GVDB sparse voxel dataset to find the first surface intersection using fixed-step marching followed by a binary search, then computes surface properties.
summary: GVDB Raycasting with Binary Search Surface Tracing is a GPU kernel that traces rays through sparse voxel datasets using fixed-step marching and binary search refinement to compute surface properties and screen-space flow vectors.
